title: Vietnam Renewable Grid Integration Monitor
thesis: Snowflake turns daily SCADA data from a fictional grid operator's renewable connection substations in Vietnam (utility solar, onshore wind, nearshore wind, battery storage and solar-storage hybrid connections) into in-limit grid KPIs, 7-day grid event-risk scores, voltage deviation anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on curated dynamic tables.

talking_points: In-limit SCADA samples, grid events, protection alarms per 1,000 checks and SCADA sample volume for 30 grid connection substations across 6 Vietnam cities.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it traces back to substation-day rows and the SCADA samples behind them.
The out-of-limit chart shows which event causes push the most samples outside the voltage, frequency, power factor, harmonics or ramp-rate band.
tabs.call_out: One governed set of grid connection KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which substations are likely to have the next grid event?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each substation's probability of a grid event in the next 7 days.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent labelled days, against the base rate.
Anomaly detection flags busbar voltage deviation outliers per substation, and the forecast projects network-wide SCADA sample volume for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

transition.line: How ready are the spares behind those risks?

talking_points: Connection availability and protection spares readiness (inverter and converter spare modules, cable joint kits, battery cooling units and power quality meters) frame the response capacity.
PM compliance against in-limit SCADA samples by substation shows where maintenance discipline and grid code compliance move together; it is an association, not proof of cause.
The action memo drafts three prioritised actions from the KPI, grid event, cause and risk tables only.
show: PM compliance vs in-limit SCADA samples
tabs.call_out: Grounded draft actions, with a human in the loop

transition.line: What happens when a substation raises a voltage alarm right now?

talking_points: Live substation SCADA readings (busbar voltage deviation and transformer loading, in %) land in RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY, from the simulator or from AWS IoT Core through S3 and Snowpipe.
The Snowflake alert logs ALARM readings with an SOP hint and the substation's current risk band, then emails the on-call dispatch engineer.
tabs.call_out: From alarm to action in one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for metrics, and Cortex Search over synthetic grid event SOPs.
Each answer shows the generated SQL and the SOPs it cited.

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Two builds share one core: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake (IoT Core, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q).
Everything shown is synthetic demo data, rebuilt reproducibly from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
